title: Reading skills
standfirst: How to read a French text that has words you have never seen.
summary: Cognates, context and punctuation — the three ways into an unknown text.

rules.lead: Cognates — words that look like English
rules.body: touristes, monument, populaire, visité, cuisine. If it looks like an English word, it probably is one. Guess it and read on.

rules.lead: Context — use the words around it
rules.body: Chaque année, des millions de touristes… — you may not know chaque, but année and millions de touristes make “every year” the only sensible reading.

rules.lead: Punctuation — it tells you the kind of sentence
rules.body: A ? marks a question and a ! marks an exclamation. A capital letter starts a name or a sentence. In an answer-in-English task that is often enough to know what is being asked.

notes.lead: Two tasks on the paper are exactly this
notes.body: The teacher said a couple of tasks check general reading skills on language that has not been taught. Nothing to learn by heart — this is a method, and the way to get it is to do R-E a few times.
